name: oh-my-setting
description: Shared coding-agent routing, handoff, guard, and content-free telemetry hooks for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Routing, handoff, guards, and private local telemetry for Codex.
interface.longDescription: oh-my-setting adds local Codex hooks that route prompts to installed skills, preserve pre-compaction handoffs, guard high-risk coding turns, and retain content-free lifecycle counters without prompts, commands, or output. With the OMS MCP server installed on the project host, ask for the current project’s panel status in chat.
defaultPrompt: Show the current project’s OMS panel status, active leads and recorded results.
